title: Hayden Panettiere Remembered by Nashville Costars and Fans After Her Death at 36
text:
Former costars and friends are paying tribute to Hayden Panettiere after her death in South Carolina. Authorities reported no signs of trauma and said the cause of death remains pending further investigation and additional studies.
The entertainment world is mourning the death of Hayden Panettiere, the actor and singer best known for her work in Heroes and the country music drama Nashville.
Panettiere died at the age of 36 on Sunday, August 16, after she was found unresponsive at a residence in Greenville, South Carolina. Emergency responders and local authorities were notified, and she was later pronounced dead. The circumstances surrounding her death remain under investigation, and officials have not issued a final cause of death. The Greenville County Coroner's Office said that an examination found no signs of trauma that would have contributed to her death.
Officials added that an official determination would depend on further investigation and the completion of additional studies. While some early reports have described the death as involving a suspected overdose, authorities have not publicly confirmed that conclusion. The absence of a definitive finding has led representatives and family members to ask the public to allow investigators time to complete their work and to respect the privacy of those closest to Panettiere.
Panettiere's former Nashville colleagues have shared emotional tributes recalling both her talent and her personality. Connie Britton, who played a central role in the series, described the loss as deeply painful and said she was struggling to find words for the sadness. Charles Esten, who portrayed Deacon Claybourne, remembered meeting Panettiere during his first audition for the show. He recalled that she had listened from outside the room and greeted him with an enthusiastic smile after he finished singing.
Esten said the moment stayed with him, and that years later, when he officially joined the cast, Panettiere repeated the same playful welcome on the Nashville set. Jonathan Jackson, Panettiere's costar on the series, also spoke about their close professional and personal bond. He described her as bright, sensitive, funny, witty and exceptionally gifted, while emphasizing her empathy and compassion.
Jackson said that both actors had grown up in the entertainment industry and shared an understanding of the intense pressures that can accompany early fame. He remembered Panettiere as focused, spontaneous and brilliant, and said the trust they developed as coworkers became the foundation of a lasting friendship.
He and his wife, he added, cherished Panettiere like a sister and hoped throughout their years of working together that she would recognize how deeply she was loved and find the peace she sought. Panettiere's death has also renewed public attention on the loss of Michelle Trachtenberg, her former costar in the 2005 film Ice Princess. Trachtenberg died less than two years earlier, and fans have drawn emotional connections between the two performers, who appeared together as young actors.
Blake Lively, who worked with Trachtenberg on Gossip Girl, shared a clip from Ice Princess and encouraged people to show kindness, noting that individuals may be facing private struggles that are not visible to others. Fans have posted messages mourning both actors and reflecting on the impact they had on audiences who watched them grow up on screen. Alongside the tributes, attention has focused on Panettiere's advocacy and charitable work.
Before her death, she participated in a campaign criticizing the treatment of marine animals kept in extreme captivity at theme parks around the world. The campaign featured her in a bathtub as part of a visual protest intended to draw attention to the conditions faced by captive animals. Her career included acting, music and activism, and supporters have highlighted those different parts of her life while remembering her legacy.
Panettiere's family, friends and former colleagues continue to grieve as authorities work to establish the full circumstances of her death
